# VV Work

> VV Work is a platform for finding jobs, employees, and verified employers across Europe.

VV Work helps candidates discover job opportunities across European countries and helps employers connect with potential employees.

## Main pages

- Home: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en
- Ukrainian version: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/uk
- Contacts: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en/contacts
- Privacy Policy: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en/privacy-policy
- Cookie Policy: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en/cookie-policy
- Terms of Use: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en/terms

## Main content

The website provides:

- Job vacancies across Europe
- Job search by country and category
- Information about verified employers
- Partner and employer profiles
- Recruitment opportunities for employers
- Information for candidates looking for work in Europe

## Languages

VV Work is available in:

- English: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/en
- Ukrainian: https://vv-work-test-ivory.vercel.app/uk
